name: listDeleteAt
description:
Deletes an element from a list.
Returns a copy of the list, without the specified element.
syntax: listDeleteAt( string list, number position, [string delimiters], [boolean includeEmptyFields] )

params.name: position
params.description: position of the element to delete

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if set to true, empty values are included as well
